@@ -7,7 +7,12 @@
 # Only MAJOR and MINOR tags build (vX.Y.0): a patch tag (vX.Y.Z, Z > 0) is
 # pushed as a marker and builds nothing - the Actions budget is spent on
 # releases that carry features (AGENTS.md "Versioning is semantic").
-# workflow_dispatch builds any ref by hand.
+# workflow_dispatch builds any ref by hand (it builds every platform but
+# publishes nothing: only a tag run reaches the publish job).
+# Graph (#125): windows, linux and macos start at once; snap and flatpak
+# repackage linux's tarball; publish waits for all five with !cancelled(),
+# puts every asset that was built on the release page and names any
+# platform whose build failed, so one broken package never withholds the rest.
 name: Release
 on:
   push:
@@ -17,11 +22,12 @@ on:
 env:
   CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
 
-# Creating a GitHub Release and uploading its assets needs write access to
-# the repo's contents; the default GITHUB_TOKEN is read-only (403 "Resource
-# not accessible by integration" on v0.8.1's first run).
+# Build jobs only read the repo. Creating a GitHub Release and uploading
+# its assets needs write access to the repo's contents (403 "Resource not
+# accessible by integration" on v0.8.1's first run): only the publish job
+# gets it.
 permissions:
-  contents: write
+  contents: read
 
 jobs:
   linux:
@@ -153,9 +159,12 @@ jobs:
           path: dist/*.flatpak
           if-no-files-found: error
 
-  release:
-    needs: [linux, macos, snap, flatpak]
+  windows:
     runs-on: windows-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+    outputs:
+      version: ${{ steps.zip.outputs.version }}
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v4
       - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
@@ -183,6 +192,7 @@ jobs:
           & scripts/sign.ps1 -Path target/release/camcraft-ui.exe, target/release/camcraft-cli.exe, target/release/post.exe
           if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "sign.ps1 exited with $LASTEXITCODE" }
       - name: Assemble portable zip
+        id: zip
         shell: pwsh
         run: |
           $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
@@ -192,6 +202,7 @@ jobs:
           $ver = ((& ".\target\release\post.exe" --version) -split '\s+')[1]
           if (-not $ver) { throw "cannot read the version from post.exe" }
           "CAMCRAFT_VERSION=$ver" | Out-File -Append -Encoding utf8 $env:GITHUB_ENV
+          "version=$ver" | Out-File -Append -Encoding utf8 $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT
           $stage = "dist/camcraft-$ver-win-x64"
           New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force `
               "$stage/assets/posts", "$stage/assets/machines", "$stage/assets/ui", `
@@ -229,26 +240,54 @@ jobs:
         with:
           name: portable-zip
           path: dist/*.zip
+          if-no-files-found: error
       - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
         with:
           name: installer
           path: dist/*-setup.exe
+          if-no-files-found: error
+
+  publish:
+    # Runs after every build job whatever their result (but not on a
+    # cancelled run), and only for a tag: a workflow_dispatch run builds
+    # everything and publishes nothing.
+    needs: [windows, linux, macos, snap, flatpak]
+    if: ${{ !cancelled() && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: write
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      # Every artifact the build jobs managed to upload, flattened into
+      # dist/. A failed platform simply has none; the asset count below is
+      # the guard, so an empty download does not end the job before it can
+      # say so.
       - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
+        continue-on-error: true
         with:
-          name: linux-packages
-          path: dist
-      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
-        with:
-          name: macos-packages
-          path: dist
-      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
-        with:
-          name: snap-package
-          path: dist
-      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
-        with:
-          name: flatpak-package
           path: dist
+          merge-multiple: true
+      - name: Version of this release
+        shell: pwsh
+        env:
+          WIN_VERSION: ${{ needs.windows.outputs.version }}
+          TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
+        run: |
+          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist | Out-Null
+          # The Windows job reads the version from the post.exe it built; when
+          # that job failed, the workspace manifest stands in (pwsh 7 parses
+          # cargo metadata JSON fine; it was PowerShell 5.1 that did not).
+          $meta = cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1 | ConvertFrom-Json
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "cargo metadata exited with $LASTEXITCODE" }
+          $ver = @($meta.packages | Where-Object { $_.name -eq 'camcraft-post' })[0].version
+          if (-not $ver) { throw "cannot read camcraft-post's version from cargo metadata" }
+          if ($env:WIN_VERSION -and $env:WIN_VERSION -ne $ver) {
+            throw "post.exe says $env:WIN_VERSION but the manifest says $ver"
+          }
+          if ($env:TAG -ne "v$ver") { throw "tag $env:TAG does not name version v$ver" }
+          "CAMCRAFT_VERSION=$ver" | Out-File -Append -Encoding utf8 $env:GITHUB_ENV
+          Get-ChildItem dist
       # The release page shows only this version's notes: RELEASE_NOTES.md
       # keeps every release, newest first, separated by a line "---"; the
       # body is its first section (user, 2026-11-07: "just what is in that
@@ -259,12 +298,17 @@ jobs:
       # reports) and a thank-you list of the GitHub authors of every commit
       # since the previous release tag (user, 2026-11-07).
       - name: Release page from the template
-        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
         shell: pwsh
         env:
           GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
           TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
           REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
+          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
+          RESULT_WINDOWS: ${{ needs.windows.result }}
+          RESULT_LINUX: ${{ needs.linux.result }}
+          RESULT_MACOS: ${{ needs.macos.result }}
+          RESULT_SNAP: ${{ needs.snap.result }}
+          RESULT_FLATPAK: ${{ needs.flatpak.result }}
         run: |
           $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
           $lines = @(Get-Content RELEASE_NOTES.md | ForEach-Object { $_.TrimEnd() })
@@ -314,10 +358,36 @@ jobs:
           $body = $body.Replace('{{REPO_URL}}', "https://github.com/$env:REPO")
           $body = $body.Replace('{{NOTES}}', $notes)
           $body = $body.Replace('{{CONTRIBUTORS}}', $thanks)
+
+          # Every build job that did not succeed (failed, or skipped because
+          # linux failed) is named on the page; the run itself stays red.
+          $platforms = [ordered]@{
+            'Windows (zip, installer)' = $env:RESULT_WINDOWS
+            'Linux (tar.gz, deb, rpm, AppImage)' = $env:RESULT_LINUX
+            'macOS (zip, dmg)' = $env:RESULT_MACOS
+            'Snap' = $env:RESULT_SNAP
+            'Flatpak' = $env:RESULT_FLATPAK
+          }
+          $missing = @($platforms.Keys | Where-Object { $platforms[$_] -ne 'success' })
+          if ($missing.Count -gt 0) {
+            $body = $body.TrimEnd() + "`n`n"
+            foreach ($m in $missing) {
+              $body += "> Not in this release: $m build did not succeed (job result: $($platforms[$m])) - see [the workflow run]($env:RUN_URL).`n"
+            }
+          }
           Set-Content -Encoding utf8 -NoNewline dist/release-body.md -Value $body
           Get-Content dist/release-body.md
+      - name: At least one asset to publish
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          shopt -s nullglob
+          assets=(dist/*.zip dist/*-setup.exe dist/*.tar.gz dist/*.deb dist/*.rpm dist/*.dmg dist/*.AppImage dist/*.snap dist/*.flatpak)
+          if [ ${#assets[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
+            echo "::error::no platform built an asset - nothing to publish"
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          printf '%s\n' "${assets[@]}"
       - name: Publish GitHub Release
-        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
         uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
         with:
           files: |
@@ -331,4 +401,6 @@ jobs:
             dist/*.snap
             dist/*.flatpak
           body_path: dist/release-body.md
-          fail_on_unmatched_files: true
+          # A failed platform leaves its globs empty; the step above already
+          # refused a release with no asset at all.
+          fail_on_unmatched_files: false
